standard_prerequisites.use: First order thickenings of algebraic spaces, conormal sheaves, and the classification of square-zero extensions; the comparison is retained.

core_obligations: Show that flatness of f' together with the fibre-product condition is equivalent to the conormal map being an isomorphism.
Express both sides through the square-zero extension classes and compare them.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the two square-zero extensions of the thickenings.
Relate flatness to the fibre-product condition.
Identify the conormal map's bijectivity with that condition.

difficulty_reason: Given a morphism of first order thickenings of algebraic spaces whose restriction to the closed parts is flat, the lemma shows that f' is flat with X the fibre product over the thickening exactly when the canonical map from the pullback of the conormal sheaf to the conormal sheaf of X in X' is an isomorphism. The proof compares the two square-zero extensions defining the thickenings, expresses the fibre-product condition as the vanishing of the difference of the extension classes, and relates that vanishing to bijectivity of the conormal map. Identifying flatness with the fibre-product condition and then with the conormal isomorphism is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 4002-4040.
